sources.description: Anthropic's managed directory of Claude Code plugins. The largest source by far, and the first one to look in: a plugin here brings its own skills, commands and .mcp.json.
Anthropic's own Agent Skills, published as a marketplace. Small and deliberately so: these are the reference skills, not a catalogue.
The plugins that ship alongside the Claude Code CLI itself, in the CLI's own repository.
A large community marketplace of agent and workflow plugins that targets several harnesses, not only Claude Code.
Community subagent collections packaged as plugins, grouped by domain.
Multi-agent orchestration plugins from the project formerly published as ruvnet/claude-flow.
